sentences.en: The unusual exothermal transformation of nacre aragonite to calcite is perhaps resulted from the stored excess enthalpy in nanometer-size aragonite of nacre.

sentences.en: The exothermal reaction of the iron sulfide in oil storage tanks was the main cause of self-ignition of the oil products.

sentences.en: The most important exothermal reactions in the crust can be expected from the chemical transformations of sulfides.

sentences.en: A comparison of the study on the crystallization of the glasses in argon with that in the air suggests that the second exothermal peaks are oxidation peaks.
